jobs.description:
**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Applications)**

Improvix Technologies | Federal Program | Fully Remote

**Location:** Fully Remote (U.S.)

**Clearance:** Active Secret clearance required.

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**THE ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM DOESN’T DEPLOY ITSELF**

Every data and AI program reaches the same moment. The architecture is approved, the model works in a notebook, and the integration pattern looks clean on a whiteboard. Then someone has to build the service, wire it into ServiceNow and the identity provider, get it through the pipeline and the security scan, and keep it running when an upstream API changes its response format overnight. That person is usually the difference between a capability that ships and one that stays a slide.

Improvix Technologies is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to build and own the application services, APIs, and enterprise integrations that turn a federal data and AI program into working capability. You’ll take capabilities from design through production — through the security pipeline and the authorization process — and you’ll own what you build after it goes live.

This is a hands-on software engineering role, and it’s fully remote. The team already has deep AI and data expertise in an AI Solutions Architect, platform and agent infrastructure depth in a Senior Agentic Platform Engineer, and a Technical Delivery & Integration Lead who clears the path across partner teams. What it needs is the engineer who builds and connects the services between them. If your strength is infrastructure alone, or models alone, this will be a harder fit than the title suggests.

* **Genuinely remote, genuinely cleared.** A cleared federal data and AI role you can do from anywhere in the U.S. is genuinely rare. That’s not a perk we bolted on — it’s how the program runs.
